summary: Round send button that turns into a stop button with an orbiting ring while a reply streams, then closes the ring with sparks on completion.

props.name: running
props.description: Controlled running state. Use with `onRunningChange`. Setting it from outside switches the look with the icon animation but calls no event callback.

props.name: demoDuration
props.description: Seconds after which a send completes on its own, for demos. `0` means the button waits for `complete()` or a stop. Read on each send.

props.name: onRunningChange
props.description: Called when a send, stop or completion changes the running state.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when the idle button is pressed or `send()` is called.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when a running send is stopped with the button or `stop()`.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when a running send completes, after the ring has closed (about 380 ms after `complete()`).

methods.description: Switches to the running state and calls `onSend`. Ignored while running.
Returns to idle and calls `onStop`. Ignored when idle and while the ring is closing.
Closes the ring, bursts sparks, returns to idle and calls `onComplete`. Ignored when idle or already completing.

keyboard.action: Send when idle, stop while running.

accessibility: A native `<button>` whose `aria-label` switches between "Send" and "Stop".
The arrow, stop icon and ring are `aria-hidden`.
There is no live region; completion is not announced.
motion: With reduced motion the arrow and stop icons swap without animation, the ring does not spin, and no sparks fire on completion.
notes: The button carries `data-state="running"` or `data-state="idle"` for styling.
The button does not stream anything itself: call `complete()` through `ref` when the reply finishes, or set `demoDuration` for a demo.
Once `complete()` starts, a stop is ignored until the ring has closed, so a send never reports both outcomes.
